name: nc-cdl-trainer
description: Practice questions with spaced repetition for the North Carolina CDL knowledge tests. 400+ questions from the NC Commercial Driver Manual with FSRS-6 scheduling, mock exams, and progress tracking. No dependencies, runs entirely in the browser.

paragraphs: Practice questions with spaced repetition for the North Carolina commercial driver license knowledge tests and the NCDOT escort vehicle operator certification. The bank has 562 multiple-choice questions covering all 13 sections of the NC Commercial Driver Manual and all 5 chapters of the NCDOT Escort Vehicle Operator Handbook, and every question cites the manual page it was drawn from, as a link that opens the PDF at that page.

Live at nc-cdl.ullberg.io, or run it yourself. There is no build step, no dependencies, and no server. Just open index.html in a browser. All progress is stored locally in the browser and never sent anywhere. Settings has export and import for backups or for moving between devices.
